title: The Turtle and the Plastic Bag

paragraphs.text: Last Sunday, my family went to Ocean Park. We walked into a long blue tunnel. It was longer than a school bus.
paragraphs.translation: 上个星期天，我们全家去了海洋乐园。我们走进一条长长的蓝色隧道。它比一辆校车还要长。

paragraphs.text: A dolphin swam over our heads. She was faster than a small boat. My sister laughed and waved her hand.
paragraphs.translation: 一只海豚从我们头顶游过。她比一艘小船还快。妹妹笑着挥了挥手。

paragraphs.text: Then a big sea turtle came near us. It was slower than the dolphin. A plastic bag was on its leg.
paragraphs.translation: 这时，一只大海龟慢慢靠近我们。它比海豚慢多了。它的腿上挂着一个塑料袋。

paragraphs.text: A young worker helped the turtle at once. He took the plastic bag away. The turtle looked happier than before.
paragraphs.translation: 一位年轻的工人马上过来帮助海龟。他把塑料袋取了下来。海龟看起来比以前开心多了。

paragraphs.text: We learned a good lesson that day. We must keep our ocean clean. We can do more than we think.
paragraphs.translation: 那天我们学到了很好的一课。我们必须让大海保持干净。我们能做的，比自己想象的更多。

paragraphs.text: Now I bring my bag to the beach. I want to help the sea too.
paragraphs.translation: 现在我去海边都会自己带袋子。我也想要帮助大海。

quiz.audioText: Which animal was faster than a small boat?

quiz.question: What was on the sea turtle's leg?
